liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **New Minglewood Blues** (1 review): Keith sounded interested, making this track stand out as a highlight [12]
- **They Love Each Other** (1 review): This song was also noted as sounding particularly good to the listener [12]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): The transition into Fire On The Mountain is described as superb [10]
- **Samson And Delilah** (1 review): Described as the most rocking version of this song ever recorded [14]

## The recordings

- **gd1978-01-31.123059.sbd.miller.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 18 songs; 157 min; rated 4.89/5 by 9 [1]
- **gd1978-01-31.sbd.miller.32256.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 18 songs; 156 min; rated 4.22/5 by 18 [2]. Said about its sound: Bright, focused sound quality, particularly noticeable during this performance; The recording is characterized by crystal clear sound and superb playing [8][13]
- **gd1978-01-31.158700.sony.ecm99.mckenzie.miller.clugston.flac16**: audience recording; 18 songs; 153 min; rated 2/5 by 2 [4]
- **gd1978-01-31.sbd.unknown.1807.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 10 songs; 101 min; rated 2/5 by 3 [6]. Said about its sound: Clear, balanced SBD suffers interference and dropouts during this specific track [7]

## Around the show

- The band's patience is audible, reflecting their experience playing to small audiences [15]
- The reviewer identifies this as the first show they ever attended [16]
- January 1978 shows are strong, leading into excellent performances on February 3 and 5 [8]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1978-01-31.123059.sbd.miller.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat -> CD [1]. Also: Jim Wise provided the discs, and Joe B. Jones assisted with pitch correction [1]
- **gd1978-01-31.sbd.miller.32256.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Audio disks from Jim Wise; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat -> CD -> FLAC [2]
- **gd1978-01-31.158700.sony.ecm99.mckenzie.miller.clugston.flac16**: taped by Tim Powell;Tim McKenzie; transferred by Charlie Miller, Scott Clugston; source: Master FOB Audience Cassettes (possibly Tim Powell); Sony ECM-99 mics > (most likely) Sony TC-152 > Reel to Reel > Tim McKenzie's DAT 16 bit/44.1 kHz (KAO Gold… [4]. Also: Tim McKenzie supplied source discs, while Charlie Miller handled the transfer and coordination; Audience sources from Jack Warner, Matt Vernon, and JCotsman patched specific transitions [4]
- **gd1978-01-31.sbd.unknown.1807.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Mike Parillo; source: SBDMR>Cass>DAT>CDR>EAC>SHN [6]
